reports.title: Front-distance condition is not a guard
locus_names: human driving mode to autonomous state
reports.expected: The HumanDrivingMode to AutonomousMode alternative is selected by guard front_distance > 10.
reports.observed: The exact transition has trigger front_distance_10 and no parsed guard; the required front_distance > 10 condition is not represented as a guard. Author source: PlantUML line 12: `HumanDrivingMode --> AutonomousMode : front_distance > 10`.
reports.candidate_reason: The endpoint is exact, but the independently required guard property is not satisfied. The model's event/trigger carrier cannot be treated as the required guard.
reports.candidate_basis: NL4 requires the front_distance condition as the selecting guard for the human-driving-to-autonomous alternative. The exact closed transition from HumanDrivingMode to AutonomousMode is transition:line:20, and its parsed trigger is front_distance_10 while its guard is empty.

binding.basis: exact element reference/name resolution over ModelIR
binding.reason: All candidate model elements resolve to stable references in the closed FCSTM input.

reports.root_cause_cluster_key: boolean front-distance condition authored as transition-label text instead of a separate guard carrier
reports.reason: The report's carrier fact is true, but the condition is visibly authored in label text. The separate-guard defect reading and the compatible label-expression reading both survive, so this is D1. Backend ownership is VALID_NOVEL because frozen core truth is VALID and every expected relation is explicitly NO_MATCH.
reports.basis: The natural language requires the comparison; the authored source contains it as unbracketed transition-label text, and derived facts corroborate the trigger/null-guard carrier.; deterministic ownership from immutable core truth and the exhaustive expected relation partition

reports.title: Return transition trigger and guard set mismatch
locus_names: autonomous state to human driving mode
reports.expected: The AutonomousMode to HumanDrivingMode return alternative is selected by the human steering command event with guard brake pressed and in AutoFinal.
reports.observed: The exact return transition has no trigger and has guard R45RouteToken == 5; the human steering command and the stated brake/AutoFinal condition are implemented on child-to-completion transitions instead. Author source: PlantUML line 13: `AutonomousMode --> HumanDrivingMode : Human Steering Cmd, Brake Pressed, in (AutoFinal)`.
